predictions.rationale: Central class representing a Sequence Diagram within the sequence2 diagram subsystem; orchestrates model, rendering, and interaction.
Provides the underlying graph model for Sequence Diagrams, mapping UML interaction elements to diagram nodes/edges.
Responsible for visual rendering of Sequence Diagram elements, linking model objects to their Fig representations.
Factory that instantiates Sequence Diagram objects and initializes their models and renderers.
Module registration class enabling the Sequence Diagram functionality within ArgoUML.
Graphic figure for messages between lifelines; core visual element unique to Sequence Diagrams.
Represents object lifelines (classifier roles) in Sequence Diagrams, key for horizontal dimension.
User interaction mode that enables creation of message edges on Sequence Diagrams.
Figure representing the vertical lifeline element, capturing the time dimension of Sequence Diagrams.
UI action that allows users to create a new Sequence Diagram within the application, directly supporting the feature's availability.
